W_XP_RANGE: the validator counts only unfiltered quests (no class or race gate): 19755 XP, 87% of the budget. Race-gated Orc/Troll wind-rider chain (1890 XP for every Durotar Horde character) and class chains are excluded; with them a typical character lands at about 96-108%: Orc Warlock ~103%, Orc Hunter ~108%, Troll Priest ~96%, Orc Warrior ~100%. Kill XP is not modelled. The 5 Forever quests without XP rows are counted at 0.
